name: TMF Plastic Solutions
old_description: Family-owned business since 1999 turned employee-owned business in 2018
about:
TMF Plastic Solutions is headquartered in Bradenton, Florida, and was founded in 1999 by Greg Kuppler and Tim Raymond. The company began as a family-owned business, its name an acronym for “Ten Mouths to Feed” reflecting the founders’ drive to support their combined ten family members. In 2018, ownership transitioned to an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), making it fully employee-owned.

The company operates as a global manufacturer of injection-molded and blow-molded plastic components, offering turnkey services from design through retail packaging. It runs over 150 injection molding machines ranging from 80 to 2,000 tons, plus injection stretch blow molding and extrusion blow molding equipment capable of up to 50-pound shot capacity. Six manufacturing and warehousing locations across the U.S. and China support production, while in-house capabilities include 3D printing (FDM and metal), CNC machining, mold flow analysis, tool design, and Class A mold building in its Dongguan facility. Assembly, first-article inspection (FAI), and PPAP approvals are standard before full production launch.

TMF serves customers needing complete product development and manufacturing solutions, though the company does not publicly list specific industry verticals. Its model emphasizes early engineering involvement, detailed DFM reports, and project milestone management to move programs from concept to mass production efficiently.

The founders’ original purpose — providing for their families — remains central to the culture, now reinforced by employee ownership. TMF highlights its long-tenured leadership, global footprint with local support, and integrated design-to-delivery approach as key differentiators.
